testing_note: Author walkthrough only (no agent run): two scratch note sets, one with a decision later contradicted, an unowned task ('someone needs to update the FAQ'), a proposal with no consensus, a 'could look into' item and an embedded instruction to mark a proposal approved; the other with no meeting details, an action without a deadline and a bare question. The walkthrough showed the skill did not say where a contradicted decision goes and that the action-item rule excluded unowned tasks, so I added the 'contested: see contradictions' marker and redefined action items as tasks recorded as needing to be done, owned or not.
applied_note: I identified the reader, trigger and stopping point first, wrote the common path as ordered steps ending in an observable 'Done when' list, and bounded the output by fixing its sections, field values ('not stated') and a five-sentence summary limit. I co-located the decision-versus-proposal rule with its ambiguity fallback, stated how to treat instructions found inside the notes beside the evidence rule, bounded missing inputs (only missing notes stop the work, with the reason), and kept everything in one file because every run needs all of it; the description is a model-invoked pointer with one trigger per branch.
